item: Server caveats, methods and reasons read in the page's language, or say they are English (row 206, part 1)
summary: said(field, template, **values) sends a server sentence's English beside one keyed frame; the page renders it with ooSaidHtml/ooSaidText (app-core.js), which looks up a keyed constant and otherwise shows the English behind the visible 'Server text, in English' label (R289). All 38 server-sentence prints in 12 client files go through it (8 page-built sites listed with a reason, zero slack); every said() template is a key in 12 languages (AST test). Keyed x12 in this part: backup verify method, the AI hardware caveat, the statistics directory, ingest, subscriptions, triangulation, revision-anomaly method and caveat, and the series comparability caveat. The first draft named the helper ooServerText, which app-core.js already declares: a single-declaration test now pins the three names.
